title.zh: Abracadabra Proposes Winding Down MIM at Four Cents on the Dollar
title.en: Abracadabra Proposes Winding Down MIM at Four Cents on the Dollar

current_state.zh: Abracadabra has proposed a Snapshot vote to liquidate the protocol, swap remaining collateral into ether and pay MIM holders pro rata, with only about $900,000 of recoverable backing against $21 million in bad debt — roughly four cents on the dollar.
